purpose: Teach: 主治医/遺言/台頭/文科/担い手/陳情/微生物/消去

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者の主治医、長年、当社にも、ご縁があった人物だ。
lines.en: The founder's personal physician—someone we've had a long relationship with through the company.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate. Opens with slight weight on the title. Pauses between clauses like laying out facts. Calm authority without drama. Eyes steady on the listener.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の遺言、社是として、引き継いでおります。
lines.en: Yes. We've inherited the founder's will as the company motto and continue to uphold it.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slight nod in the voice on 'inherited.' Steady tempo. Careful emphasis on 'continue'—showing diligence, not rote recitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、新興企業の台頭、警戒しろ。
lines.en: Watch the industry carefully. Be alert to startups gaining ground.
lines.style: Firm, measured instruction. Sharp attack on the first word. Clipped cadence. No softening—this is counsel, not suggestion. Slight lean forward in posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。文科省のガイドライン、製品開発に、活用しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're actively using MEXT guidelines in our product development.
lines.style: Precise, professional. Light emphasis on 'actively' to show concrete action. Steady pace. Confident but not overconfident—reporting progress to someone who expects accuracy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の担い手、社員、若手から、育てろ。
lines.en: Develop your future leaders from within—nurture the younger staff.
lines.style: Instructive, measured. Slight pause after the opening phrase. Emphasis on 'nurture' with care underneath—this is investment, not just direction. Steady, eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、政府への陳情活動にも、参加しております。
lines.en: Yes. Our staff are also participating in policy advocacy efforts with the government.
lines.style: Informative, engaged. Light emphasis on 'also' to show breadth of involvement. Measured pace. Showing active participation without overstatement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 微生物分野、新規事業として、検討中だ。
lines.en: We're currently exploring microbiology as a potential new business venture.
lines.style: Considered, deliberate. Slight pause before 'microbiology.' Weight on 'exploring'—early stage, thoughtful. Measured pace. Open to the next question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古いデータの消去、計画的に、進めております。
lines.en: Yes. We're systematically proceeding with the planned deletion of legacy data.
lines.style: Methodical, precise. Emphasis on 'systematically'—showing careful process. Steady, unhurried tempo. Final statement of a sequence—slight closure in the trailing tone.
